verdict.rationale: Insomnia's first-party docs describe a built-in MCP Client that connects external MCP servers to access their tools, prompts, and resources. The client discovers those elements so you can invoke, query, or test them directly in the app. The documented use is interactive testing and invocation rather than an AI agent autonomously calling the tools. missing for 10: evidence of autonomous/agentic tool use by an in-app AI, details on transports/auth and configuration depth, independent or hands-on corroboration.
